Let \(R\) be the number of rows.

- From the first condition: \(30\) students guarantee a shared row, so \(R \le 29\).
- From the second condition: even if \(26\) students occupy \(26\) distinct rows, at least \(3\) rows remain empty, so
\[
R - 26 \ge 3 \implies R \ge 29.
\]

Thus \(R = 29\).

\[
\boxed{29}
\]
